obstruction.statement: No global approximate-root ladder (k_j,l_j) is compatible with the synchronized direct route. The forced death gaps g = kbar_v/D_f,v put the chain-1 pole-adjacent vertex X (gap (nu_X+1)/(2nu_X) > 1/2, nu_X | 11305 odd, shape-independent) above F1 (gap 2/5) and every other vertex below 5/2, so the first post-pole death is X, possibly after a NON-KILLING prefix of printed-legal ladder steps (Grok finding-1 repair). While X and F1 are both alive every prefix step has k_j | 2 (Prop 4.2(iii)/Prop 8.1 integrality at X's (t-A)^2-power and F1's orbit mults (2,1,1) with i=2); the legal prefix menu in the window (gap(X), 5/2) is exactly (k,l) in {(1,2),(2,3),(2,5)} (g = 3/2, 1, 2; all delta-integral at every non-pole vertex). Case A (empty prefix): X kills level 1 with (k_1,l_1) = (2nu_X, 2nu_X+1), refused by k | 2. Case B: F1 kills level 1 first -- impossible, delta_X in N cannot skip its zero at gap(X) > 2/5 (death at X would need nu_X = -5). Case C (any nonempty prefix, r steps with k=2 and odd l, any number of k=1 steps): alpha_m = 3/2 + r/2 (mod 1), and X-death needs l_m/k_m = alpha_m - 1/2 + 1/(2nu_X) with k_m | 2: k_m = 1 forces 2nu_X | r*nu_X + 1 (impossible for r even or odd), k_m = 2 forces nu_X | 1. All three cases are refuted for every chain-1 stack: the stack is forced to be pure n=1 clean neutrals (w-freeze at 2; Delta - n = (n-1)(nu-1) >= 1), its nu-product is forced to 11305 (odd) by the f-degree ladder 2 -> 22610, and its pole-adjacent gap is shape-independent.
obstruction.checked_stacks_note: all divisors nu_X >= 2 of 11305 = 5*7*17*19 (odd, so nu_X >= 5); covers every multi-neutral stack since only the pole-adjacent vertex's gap and the F1/X caps enter; case C covers every prefix length via the r-parity closed form plus explicit r = 0..5
